headline: Congress takes a breather—Senate and House both in recess for the long Labor Day weekend!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened briefly at 8:00 a.m. on Thursday, August 27 in pro forma session and adjourned within seconds until Monday, August 31. No legislative business was conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met at 9 a.m. on Thursday, August 27 and adjourned at 9:03 a.m. Thirty-four new bills and eight resolutions were introduced, and sixteen bills received committee reports, but no floor votes or debate occurred.
